RT Sam Forman
Thrilled to be building something new at the intersection of AI and crypto, and to have the support of so many great investors.
I've been working on decentralized AI for 8 years now; I published a paper in an IEEE journal on the subject in high school (https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/8552273), continued studying it at Stanford, and started putting it into practice with @SturdyFinance. 
Bittensor is the future of decentralized AI, and decentralized AI is the future of intelligence. @_taofi_ is building the financial rails to unlock the value of machine intelligence.

TaoFi: Introducing TaoFi: the financial layer for decentralized AI, built on Bittensor.
We're excited to share that TaoFi has raised a strategic funding round led by DCG alongside Pantera, taostats, Lyrik, and others.
